# Does your GitHub Actions workflow leak a secret its own masking can't catch?

> Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find the two documented ways a secret slips past GitHub's own log masking: transforming it (base64/hex/substring) before printing, and exporting it to $GITHUB_ENV/$GITHUB_OUTPUT without ::add-mask::. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
